module_summary: Memory-to-banks splitter wrapper: a single detailed child splits each wide memory request into per-bank requests via request FIFOs and reassembles bank responses, mapping atop onto the write-user field.

anchors.name: req_i
anchors.why: Wide memory request valid to be split across banks.

anchors.name: gnt_o
anchors.why: Grant when all bank request FIFOs can accept.

anchors.name: addr_i
anchors.why: Byte address of wide request, remapped per bank.

anchors.name: wdata_i
anchors.why: Wide write data sliced into per-bank write data.

anchors.name: we_i
anchors.why: Write enable selecting read or write request.

anchors.name: rvalid_o
anchors.why: Response valid once all bank responses recombined.

anchors.name: rdata_o
anchors.why: Wide read data recombined from bank responses.

anchors.name: bank_req_o
anchors.why: Per-bank request valid from request FIFOs.

anchors.name: bank_rvalid_i
anchors.why: Per-bank response valid into response FIFOs.

anchors.name: bank_rdata_i
anchors.why: Per-bank read data into response FIFOs.

anchors.name: atop_i
anchors.why: Atomic operation code passed as write-user field.

anchors.name: clr_i
anchors.why: Synchronous clear of the splitter FIFOs.

groups.name: bank_splitter
groups.description: Request/response FIFOs splitting a wide access into bank accesses.
